name: tpl-existence-1-goal~p2
task: Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) hard makes reaching the goal required, and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard forbids at_goal before the first has_key; together they force grabbing the key first, exactly matching 'Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal'. The hard Existence(at_goal) with the hard Precedence already forces has_key, so no Existence(has_key) is needed and none is present, and the machine correctly rejects at_goal without has_key and finishes only on at_goal with has_key.

texts: Acquire the key before reaching the goal.
